item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): The 2026-10-06 entry for this record said the 2033 date…
item.description: The 2026-10-06 entry for this record said the 2033 date comes from the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance. That was wrong. The Port's 2017 staff report (Item 9B, p.7) puts the Schedule of Performance in the Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA) between the Port and the developer, which is a different agreement from the Development Agreement between the City and the developer. The report says the developer must complete phase 2 within 16 years of project approval, but it never states the year 2033; 2033 is Pier & Point's own arithmetic (2017 plus 16 years). It stays labelled a legal outside date, not an expected completion. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): The date shown for this parcel comes from the…
item.description: The date shown for this parcel comes from the Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA)'s Schedule of Performance, which is separate from the City's Development Agreement. The Port's report gives only years after Project approval, and the calendar year shown is Pier & Point's own arithmetic from 2017, before any extension for delay. It remains labelled a legal outside date, not a forecast. Source: Port of San Francisco, Item 9B: Pier 70 Mixed-Use Project approvals, Sep 22, 2017 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Item 11A: Pier 70 28-Acre Site Project update, Aug 7, 2026 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): The 2033 date on this record was drawn as an expected…
item.description: The 2033 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 2 within 16 years of approval), not a construction schedule. It is now labelled a legal deadline and no longer moves this record's status on the map or the timeline. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): The 2033 completion milestone is now labelled a soft…
item.description: The 2033 completion milestone is now labelled a soft 2017 outside date that down market delay has tolled and Port Item 11A proposes to reset, not a current expectation. Resolution 17-52 is described as the Parcel K North sale approval that subdivides the whole 20th/Illinois parcel, and the DDA is said to cover Parcel K South's horizontal improvements but not its vertical option. The Oct 24, 2017 Board hearing is described as scheduled rather than held, the Item 11A milestone is dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report, and the Irish Hill Corner Plaza is placed at the HDY3/HDY1/2 corner. The map notes say Parcel K South is a Port parcel outside Brookfield's site and drop an uncited brochure. The D4D citation no longer calls it an 'adopted' document. Source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 SUD Design for Development, updated 2022-04-26 (https://www.sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline=).

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026)… (Aug 7, 2026)
item.description: Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026) lists Parcel K South as the Phase 2 affordable site; the developer is responsible for horizontal improvements to it under the DDA; gap-funding sources 'currently unavailable' (Aug 7, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): The DDA's Schedule of Performance sets completion… (~2033)
item.description: The DDA's Schedule of Performance sets completion of Phase 2 at 16 years after Project approval; Pier & Point's arithmetic from 2017 gives about 2033 (the Port's report states no calendar year). Not a current forecast for this stand-alone affordable parcel, which Port Item 11A places in Phase 2 and the Port's proposed 2026 phasing plan groups in subphase 2B, and whose gap funding is not yet available (~2033). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): Port Commission meeting at which… (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: Port Commission meeting at which Resolution 17-52 was scheduled for adoption; its recitals state the Port 'intends to vacate an approximately 12' portion of Michigan Street' and 'subdivide the resulting merged parcel into four new parcels: the Plaza Parcel, Parcel K North, the 21st Street right-of-way extension parcel, and Parcel K South. Parcel K South will be developed as an affordable housing site' (the recitals state an intent; this record has not read a source showing the subdivision was carried out) (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.

item.title: Planned · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): Port Commission Resolution 17-52 (the… (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: Port Commission Resolution 17-52 (the Parcel K North sale approval) has the Port subdivide the 20th/Illinois parcel into four parcels (the Plaza Parcel, Parcel K North, the 21st Street right-of-way extension parcel and Parcel K South), with Parcel K South to be 'developed as an affordable housing site'; the 28-Acre DDA excludes Parcel K South from the developer's vertical option, but Port Item 11A says the DDA makes the developer responsible for its horizontal improvements (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): Resolution of Intention to form… (Jul 25, 2017)
item.description: Resolution of Intention to form Infrastructure and Revitalization Financing District No. 2 (Hoedown Yard), to finance affordable housing within Pier 70 and Parcel K South, introduced at the Board of Supervisors (File 170880; Port Item 9B says July 25, 2017 in its text and 7/27/17 in its Table 9). Item 9B says the resolution calls a hearing for October 24, 2017, but the Board's record shows the file passed on July 26, 2018 (Resolution 234-18) with a title that calls the hearing for September 11, 2018, so the October 2017 hearing date was not kept; whether the district has been formed is not established here (Jul 25, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22; San Francisco Board of Supervisors (Legistar web API record), 2018-07-26.
